item.title: A URL Journey
item.description: I was recently asked, “What happens when you type a URL into your browser?” It’s a question that always makes me pause, trying to gauge the right level of detail. This time, I clearly missed the mark. In hindsight, I should have asked some clarifying questions to better understand the depth of knowledge the person was seeking. It’s a lesson I know well, but sometimes, in the heat of the moment, even the simplest things can trip us up.
